oak-cutting-board.name: Oak cutting board
oak-cutting-board.short: Solid oak, oil finish, juice groove on one side.
oak-cutting-board.description: Cut from a single piece of oak with no glued joints. The working side has a juice groove; the back is flat and works for serving. We engrave the back so a knife never wears the words away.

walnut-serving-board.name: Walnut serving board with handle
walnut-serving-board.short: Dark walnut with a long handle, for cheese and bruschetta.
walnut-serving-board.description: American walnut has a deep chocolate colour, so the engraving comes out light and crisp. The handle has a hole for hanging the board in the kitchen.

round-pizza-board.name: Round pizza board
round-pizza-board.short: Beech, 34 cm across, fits a 30–32 cm pizza.
round-pizza-board.description: A wide rim all the way round for the engraving: a name, your home "pizzeria" or a dough recipe. Beech is dense and does not soak up smells.

recipe-board.name: Grandma's recipe board
recipe-board.short: A recipe of up to 600 characters, in handwriting or a font.
recipe-board.description: Send us a photo of a handwritten recipe and we carry the handwriting onto the wood, or pick one of our fonts. The board can be used, but most people hang it on the wall.

cheese-set.name: Cheese set: board and three knives
cheese-set.short: Acacia, knives held by magnets in the edge.
cheese-set.description: Three knives for hard, soft and crumbly cheese sit in the edge of the board on magnets. The engraving goes in the centre of the top.

wooden-spatula-set.name: Beech spatula set
wooden-spatula-set.short: Three spatulas: straight, angled and slotted.
wooden-spatula-set.description: Hand-sanded and finished with food-safe oil. Each handle fits a short word or initials.

rolling-pin-pattern.name: Patterned rolling pin
rolling-pin-pattern.short: A laser-cut pattern for gingerbread and cookies.
rolling-pin-pattern.description: The pattern covers the whole roller, so the dough takes the design straight away. Choose snowflakes, vyshyvanka embroidery or flowers.

bamboo-board-kids.name: Bamboo board for kids
bamboo-board-kids.short: Small and light, with an animal and a name.
bamboo-board-kids.description: 24×16 cm with rounded corners. We engrave the picture and the name so a child knows the board is theirs.

knife-block.name: Magnetic knife block
knife-block.short: Walnut, holds up to six knives.
knife-block.description: The magnets are hidden inside, so the blades touch only wood. There is room on the front for a kitchen name or a family name.

bifold-wallet.name: Bifold wallet
bifold-wallet.short: Six cards, a note section, hand stitched.
bifold-wallet.description: Vegetable-tanned leather darkens and gains a patina over time. We engrave initials outside or a short message inside.

card-holder.name: Card holder
card-holder.short: Four cards and a pocket for receipts.
card-holder.description: Slim enough for a shirt pocket. A favourite for corporate gifts with a logo.

passport-cover.name: Passport cover
passport-cover.short: For an ID card and a travel passport.
passport-cover.description: Two pockets for an ID card and a boarding pass. Engraving on the front or inside on the flap.

key-holder-leather.name: Leather key holder
key-holder-leather.description: Keys no longer scratch the phone in your pocket. A handy housewarming gift together with the first key to a new flat.

leather-belt.name: Classic belt
leather-belt.description: We engrave the inside of the belt near the buckle: a wedding date or a short phrase only the owner will see.

leather-keychain.name: Keychain with initials
leather-keychain.short: A small gift that will certainly be used.
leather-keychain.description: From ten pieces there is a discount, so keychains are often ordered for a team or a class.

dopp-kit.name: Travel toiletry bag
dopp-kit.description: Fits everything for shaving and the shower. Engraving on the side: a name or the coordinates of the place where you met.

apron-leather.name: Apron with leather straps
apron-leather.description: For the grill, the workshop or a coffee shop. We engrave the leather patch on the chest.

wooden-watch.name: Wooden wristwatch
wooden-watch.short: Quartz movement, wooden bracelet sized to your wrist.
wooden-watch.description: Up to three lines engraved on the case back. We shorten the bracelet for free if you note your wrist size in the comment.

pocket-watch.name: Pocket watch
pocket-watch.description: A classic gift for the groom or the bride's father. Engraving on the outside or the inside of the lid.

cufflinks.name: Cufflinks with initials
cufflinks.description: Each cufflink fits up to three letters. They can differ: your initials and your partner's.

tie-clip.name: Tie clip
tie-clip.description: Engraved along the clip: a surname, a date or a short phrase of up to 20 characters.

bracelet-steel.name: Bar bracelet
bracelet-steel.short: A slim bar on a cord, adjustable size.
bracelet-steel.description: We engrave both sides: a name outside, a date or coordinates inside. The steel does not darken in water.

dog-tag.name: Dog tag
dog-tag.short: Tag with a chain, engraved on both sides.
dog-tag.description: The classic format with deep engraving that stays readable after years of wear.

money-clip.name: Money clip
money-clip.description: The engraving removes the black layer and reveals the metal, so the words come out in strong contrast.

leather-notebook-a5.name: A5 notebook in leather cover
leather-notebook-a5.description: When the pages run out, the block can be replaced and the cover stays. We engrave a logo, a name or a quote.

wooden-pen.name: Walnut pen
wooden-pen.description: The body is turned on a lathe; up to 25 characters engraved along the pen.

desk-organizer.name: Desk organiser
desk-organizer.short: Holds a phone, pens and business cards.
desk-organizer.description: The phone stands at an angle and can charge through a cable slot. Engraving on the front panel.

phone-stand.name: Phone stand
phone-stand.short: Folds flat to throw in a bag.
phone-stand.description: A two-piece bamboo stand. Popular as corporate merch: we engrave a logo, with a discount from 20 pieces.

business-card-box.name: Wooden business card box
business-card-box.description: The lid is held by magnets, so cards never spill in a bag.

planner-undated.name: Undated planner
planner-undated.short: For a year, fabric cover, ribbon bookmark.
planner-undated.description: A linen cover with an engraved leather patch. Start in any month.

laptop-stand.name: Laptop stand
laptop-stand.short: Raises the screen by 12 cm, comes apart.
laptop-stand.description: Three parts that slot together with no glue or screws. Engraving on the front panel.

family-sign.name: Family name sign
family-sign.short: For a door or a wall, fixings included.
family-sign.description: Family name, the year the family was founded and the flat number. The oil finish copes with stairwells and damp.

photo-frame.name: Photo frame with an inscription
photo-frame.short: A wide margin under the photo for engraving.
photo-frame.description: A date, a place and a few words under the photo. Acrylic instead of glass, so the frame is safe to post.

wall-key-holder.name: Wall key holder
wall-key-holder.short: Five hooks and a shelf for post.
wall-key-holder.description: We engrave the name of your home or "Don't forget the keys". Hidden fixings.

night-light.name: Engraved night light
night-light.short: Acrylic panel on a wooden base, USB.
night-light.description: The picture is engraved into the acrylic and glows when the light is on. Warm white, touch button.

star-map-board.name: Star map on wood
star-map-board.short: The sky over your city on your date.
star-map-board.description: We calculate where the stars stood on the date and place you give us and engrave them on a 30×30 cm walnut panel.

wall-clock.name: Wall clock
wall-clock.description: Instead of numbers you can engrave 12 words, dates or names. The movement does not tick.

christmas-ornaments.name: Christmas ornaments with names
christmas-ornaments.description: Each family member's name on their own ornament. Free gift wrap from six pieces.

wine-glasses-pair.name: Pair of wine glasses
wine-glasses-pair.description: A name or a date on each glass. The engraving is frosted and survives the dishwasher.

whiskey-glass.name: Whisky glass
whiskey-glass.description: We engrave the side or the base. From four glasses we pack them in a wooden crate.

steel-flask.name: Steel hip flask
steel-flask.description: Engraved on both sides. On the black flask the words come out silver.

thermo-mug.name: Travel mug
thermo-mug.short: 350 ml, keeps drinks hot for 4 hours.
thermo-mug.description: The lid does not leak in a bag. The engraving removes the paint and reveals the steel.

ceramic-mug.name: Ceramic mug
ceramic-mug.short: Handmade, 300 ml, each one slightly different.
ceramic-mug.description: The glaze is dishwasher and microwave safe. The words are applied as a decal and fired in the kiln.

beer-mug.name: Beer mug
beer-mug.short: 500 ml, thick glass with a handle.
beer-mug.description: A name, your company crest or your favourite team on the side of the mug.

champagne-flutes.name: Wedding champagne flutes
champagne-flutes.short: A pair, in a gift box.
champagne-flutes.description: The couple's names and the wedding date. Both flutes come from the same batch so they match.

wooden-coasters.name: Coaster set
wooden-coasters.description: Each coaster can carry its own engraving: guests' initials, city names or labels of favourite drinks.

box-for-dad.name: "For Dad" box
box-for-dad.short: An engraved flask, coffee, sea-salt chocolate.
box-for-dad.description: Packed in a wooden crate with straw. You set the flask engraving yourself; the rest goes in as it is.

box-cozy-evening.name: "Cosy evening" box
box-cozy-evening.short: A candle, herbal tea, honey and a mug.
box-cozy-evening.description: Everything for an evening under a blanket. A kraft box with your card.

box-coffee-lover.name: "Coffee lover" box
box-coffee-lover.short: Two bags of coffee, a travel mug with a name, chocolate.
box-coffee-lover.description: The coffee is roasted to order by our partners at Obsmazhka 14. We engrave the travel mug.

box-newlyweds.name: "Newlyweds" box
box-newlyweds.short: Glasses with names, a cheese board, honey, a candle.
box-newlyweds.description: Our biggest box. We engrave the names and the date on the glasses and the board.

box-new-home.name: "New home" box
box-new-home.short: A family name sign, coasters, tea.
box-new-home.description: The first things for a new kitchen and front door. We engrave the family name on the sign.

box-team.name: "For the team" box
box-team.short: A notebook with a logo, a pen, chocolate.
box-team.description: Our basic corporate set. A discount from 10 boxes; from 30, a personal name on each notebook.

wildflower-honey.name: Wildflower honey
wildflower-honey.description: July, meadows by the Southern Bug river. The honey was never heated, so it crystallises after a few months, and that is normal.

buckwheat-honey.name: Buckwheat honey
buckwheat-honey.description: For those who like honey with character. Good with cheese and nuts.

coffee-ethiopia.name: Ethiopia coffee, whole bean
coffee-ethiopia.short: 250 g, berry and tea notes, for filter.
coffee-ethiopia.description: Light roast. The roast date is on the bag and never more than two weeks old.

coffee-brazil.name: Brazil coffee, ground
coffee-brazil.short: 250 g, chocolate and nut, for cezve and moka pot.
coffee-brazil.description: Medium roast, ground on the day we ship.

carpathian-tea.name: Carpathian herbal tea
carpathian-tea.description: No flavourings, in a tin you can reuse for spices.

dark-chocolate-salt.name: Dark chocolate with sea salt
dark-chocolate-salt.description: Cocoa beans from Ecuador, coarse sea salt on top of the bar.

milk-chocolate-nuts.name: Milk chocolate with nuts
milk-chocolate-nuts.description: We roast the nuts ourselves, so they stay crunchy.

soy-candle.name: Soy candle in glass
soy-candle.description: The beech lid can be engraved: a name or a short wish.
